⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The AMS feeds filament toward the toolhead, retracts it 3 times in a row, and pauses the print with 'HMS_0700_2000_0002_0001: Failed to feed filament into the toolhead'.

Verified technical root cause: Abrasive wear inside the internal AMS PTFE tubes or sticky spring/magnet inside the rear Filament Buffer causing the Hall sensor to miss the tension signal.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Disconnect the PTFE tube from the top of the toolhead and inspect the bend right above the extruder—carbon fiber, matte, and glow filaments saw grooves through the inner wall that snag the filament tip.
  2. Check that the sliding spring inside the rear Filament Buffer moves smoothly without binding.
  3. Replace the worn PTFE sections using 2.5mm inner diameter / 4.0mm outer diameter PTFE tubing (standard 2.0mm ID Ender 3 tubing causes excess friction in the Bambu AMS!).

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (HMS_0700_2000_0002_0001 / AMS Failed to Feed Filament)

Why must I use 2.5mm ID PTFE tube instead of standard 2.0mm ID Capricorn tubing on Bambu Lab AMS?
The Bambu AMS pushes filament through multiple tight bends at high speed; 2.0mm ID tubing creates too much drag and triggers HMS_0700_2000_0002_0001 overload errors.
